title: Stress and the Developing Brain
learningOutcomes: Understand the key ideas behind stress and the developing brain and why this topic matters for child development.
Learn practical skills and strategies that help apply stress and the developing brain in everyday parenting situations.
Build confidence using stress and the developing brain to support connection, safety, and positive family routines.

caseworkerSummary: This topic helps parents build practical skills related to stress and the developing brain. It supports safer, more consistent caregiving by improving understanding, strengthening emotional connection, and reducing stress in daily routines. This topic is suitable for parents who need guidance in applying positive parenting strategies and may benefit families working toward stability, reunification, or improved home safety.
